rows.title: Change Management Center of Excellence (CoE)
rows.summary:
This is a two-day cohort.

Based on the Prosci ADKAR® Model, the CM CoE provides CMU staff and faculty with tools to lead successful transitions by navigating the “people” side of change. You’ll learn to apply principles, create basic plans, and foster a culture of change within the university.

rows.title: Rare Books & Ancestral Machines: The Inaugural Exhibition of the Posner Center for Special Collections
rows.summary: This exhibition inaugurates University Libraries’ newly renovated Posner Center, surveying its collections and tracing more than four centuries of scientific inquiry and learning.
rows.description:
The Posner Center is a cabinet of rarities and technological marvels: paper-and-string cipher machines, centuries-old books, cogwheel computers and 19th century “digital” images. Part museum and part laboratory, it is a site for discovery, research, and innovation with the materials of the past.

Rare Books & Ancestral Machines features more than 30 books and objects from the Posner Center’s holdings. Many of these materials are on view for the first time. The exhibition inaugurates the newly renovated Center, surveying its collections and tracing more than four centuries of scientific inquiry and learning. Organized into five thematic sections — mechanical computing, robotics, cryptography, artificial intelligence, and scholarly method — the exhibit explores the histories of these disciplines, uncovering abandoned prototypes and long-forgotten technologies.

What will you discover?

Exhibit Hours

During the summer, the Posner Center operates by appointment only. Contact Sam Lemley to make an appointment to visit the exhibit.

Public open hours will resume the first full week of the fall 2026 semester as follows:

  • Monday, closed
  • Tuesday through Friday, 10 a.m.-3 p.m. (Reading Room & Exhibitions)
  • Thursday, 3-7 p.m. (Exhibitions only)

Learn more about University Libraries Special Collections.

rows.title: Coulter Welcome Center Closed
rows.summary: The Coulter Welcome Center is closed on Wednesdays. On these days, campus tours are unavailable, and visitors will be unable to pick up campus maps or informational materials in-person.
rows.description:
If you plan to visit on a Wednesday when the Coulter Welcome Center is closed and there are no campus visits, Admission counselors are available in the office or by phone from 8:30 to 4:30 p.m. (Eastern Time).

Simply drop by the Office of Undergraduate Admission on the second floor of Warner Hall, or call 412-268-2082. Visitors can collect informational material and campus maps during walk-ins.

rows.title: Open Enrollment for 2027 Benefits
rows.summary: Open Enrollment is your chance to review and update your benefits for the upcoming year. Your new benefits will take effect on Jan. 1, 2027, and will remain in place for the entire year. Log in to Workday Oct. 26 through Nov. 16 at 5 p.m. to review and/or make changes to your benefits.
